chapter: The Treasure of the Four Skerries

quests.title: Treasure Clue: Pudding Isle

dialogue.t: Uh... Until the leaves have turned red... This is kinda confusing, {NICKNAME}. Where do they want us to go anyway?
C'mon, Paimon thought we'd found it at last, but it's just like the last time...
"Wait until the leaves have turned red and yellow, then dock on the island from the west. You will be able to see a tower."
Ooh, Paimon's got it! A tower... This can only mean one thing!
Looks like we've gotta change the mountains so they look like that, {NICKNAME}.

quests.description: Go near to the reef of Pudding Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure’s location there.
